node.statement: For the W fixed in node 1.1.1, apply lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger to 0 <= epsilon <= W.epsilon_MAIN. Thus epsilon <= W.e_env and epsilon <= W.e_s2/W.K2; the scales t_atom:=W.K_call*epsilon and t_2:=W.K2*epsilon satisfy 0 <= t_atom,t_2 <= W.K_call*epsilon <= W.r_reset; and W.L*epsilon <= W.K_call*epsilon. The inequalities in lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger also give W.K2 >= W.L and D_* >= 1.
